channel.title: Clovermoor Printables
channel.description: Ideas and how-tos for printables and digital design files.

item.title: Wall Decor Ideas for Every Room, With Hanging Heights
item.description: Wall decor ideas: art prints, gallery walls, mirrors, shelves, plates, maps and textiles, plus how high to hang them (centre at 57 in) and strip weight limits.

item.title: Thanksgiving Games for Family, Kids and Adults
item.description: Thanksgiving games for every part of the day: charades and turkey bowling before dinner, gratitude and trivia games at the table, printable games for kids.

item.title: How to Make Stickers at Home: 3 Methods That Work
item.description: To make stickers at home, print on sticker paper that matches your printer at actual size, then cut by hand or with Cricut Print Then Cut, or use packing tape.

item.title: Bookmark Ideas: DIY, Kids' Designs and Standard Size
item.description: Bookmark ideas to make at home: corner, ribbon, collage, pressed-leaf and printable designs. Standard size is 2 x 6 in, with 2 x 7 and 2 x 8 also common.

item.title: Sight Words for Kindergarten: Dolch and Fry Lists
item.description: Kindergarten sight words: the 40 Dolch pre-primer and 52 primer words, Fry's first 100, what schools expect by year end, and games to practise them.

item.title: Bullet Journal Ideas: Pages and Layouts That Work
item.description: Bullet journal ideas built on the method's core pages: an index, future log, monthly and daily logs, then collections for habits, books, trips and budgets.

item.title: How to Use Digital Stickers in Goodnotes and Beyond
item.description: Digital stickers are image files, usually transparent PNGs. Save them to your tablet, add them as a Goodnotes Elements collection, then tap or drag onto a page.

item.title: Coupon Book Ideas: Lists for Partners, Mom and Kids
item.description: Coupon book ideas that get used: small favours, shared time and treats the person wants. Lists for a boyfriend, husband, mom and kids, plus how to print one.

item.title: A4 Size in Pixels: 72, 150 and 300 DPI Chart
item.description: A4 is 2480 x 3508 pixels at 300 dpi, 1240 x 1754 at 150 and 595 x 842 at 72. Chart for A5, A3, Letter and photo sizes, plus a pixels-to-print calculator.

item.title: Gallery Wall Ideas With Exact Sizes and Spacing
item.description: Gallery wall ideas for living room, bedroom, hallway and office, each with frame sizes, spacing (5 cm to start), total footprint and a centre 145 cm high.

item.title: Baby Shower Thank You Card Wording: 15 Examples
item.description: Baby shower thank you card wording: thank each guest for the exact gift and say how baby will use it. Examples for hosts, group gifts, money and late cards.

item.title: Phone Wallpaper Ideas That Work Around Clock and Icons
item.description: Phone wallpaper ideas planned for the screen: a calm Home Screen, a bolder Lock Screen, quotes below the clock, schedules, seasonal sets and a DIY template.

item.title: How to Sublimate a Mug: Steps, Time and Temperature
item.description: Print a mirrored design on sublimation paper, tape it to a poly-coated mug and press. HPN lists 385°F for 190 seconds for its 11 oz mug; yours may differ.

item.title: Party Games for Kids: Ideas by Age, Space and Prep
item.description: Party games for kids sorted by age and space: musical statues and Simon says for little ones, printable hunts and bingo for readers, and when to skip balloons.

item.title: How to Use Dot Markers: Stamping, Labels and Clean-Up
item.description: How to use dot markers: cap off, hold the bottle upright, press straight down and lift. Plus what the age label and the AP seal mean, and how to store them.

item.title: Wedding Thank You Card Wording: Notes for Every Gift
item.description: Wedding thank you card wording: name the exact gift, say how you'll use it, sign as a couple. Notes for cash, parents, helpers and late cards.

item.title: How to Make a Busy Book for Toddlers: Printable Binder
item.description: How to make a busy book for toddlers: print, laminate in 5 mil pouches, cut, add hook-and-loop dots, file in a binder, and keep pieces too big to swallow.

item.title: Twitch Overlay Size: 1920x1080 and What Else Fits
item.description: Make a Twitch overlay 1920 x 1080 px, the size of a 1080p stream and your OBS canvas; 1280 x 720 for 720p. Panels: up to 320 x 600 px, under 1 MB.

item.title: How to Print Wall Art at Home, Staples or a Photo Lab
item.description: How to print wall art: pick the file whose ratio matches your frame, print at Actual size on photo or matte paper, or order at Staples or a photo counter.

item.title: Sublimation Tumbler Wrap Size Chart, 12 to 40 oz
item.description: Tumbler wrap sizes from blank makers' specs: 20 oz skinny about 9.37 x 7.91 in, 30 oz 9.77 x 9.5 in. Same ounces can differ, so measure your own blank.

item.title: Baby Shower Games Ideas for Small and Large Groups
item.description: Baby shower games ideas sorted by group size: paper games like bingo and word scrambles for big groups, guessing and advice games for small ones. What to print.

item.title: Dot Marker Activities: Printable Ideas by Season
item.description: Dot marker activities for toddlers and preschoolers: printable dot pages, letters, numbers, a theme for every month, and what the age label on the set means.

item.title: Busy Book Ideas: Page Ideas by Age, With Safety Checks
item.description: Busy book ideas for toddlers and preschoolers: matching, posting, lift-the-flap, threading and story pages, matched to CDC milestones, with small-parts checks.

item.title: Wall Art Sizes: Chart of Ratios, Frames and Pixels
item.description: Standard wall art sizes grouped by ratio: 2:3 (4x6 to 24x36), 3:4 (12x16, 18x24), 4:5 (8x10, 16x20), ISO A4 to A1, with frames and print pixels.

item.title: Thank You Card Wording: Examples for Every Occasion
item.description: Thank you card wording that works: thank them for the exact gift, say why it mattered, close warmly. Examples by occasion, short verses and card sizes.

item.title: Phone Wallpaper Size: Pixels for iPhone, Pixel, Galaxy
item.description: The right phone wallpaper size is your screen's resolution: 1206 x 2622 px for iPhone 17, 1080 x 2424 for Pixel 11, 1080 x 2340 for Galaxy S26.

item.title: Christmas Party Games for Family, Adults and Work
item.description: Christmas party games by crowd: pass the parcel and Pin the Nose on Rudolph for families, charades and trivia for adults, low-key printables for the office.

item.title: Junk Journal Ideas: Themes, Pages and What to Put In
item.description: Junk journal ideas: pick a theme, fill pages with saved paper, tickets, envelopes and pockets, and glue in copies of newspaper so pages last.

item.title: Gender Reveal Ideas Without Smoke or Fire
item.description: Gender reveal ideas that need no flame: cake, balloon box, scratch-off cards, voting games and sibling shirts, plus why smoke devices have started wildfires.
